description.narrative: Improve public financial management systems and accountability for enhanced efficiency of social spending

The Program-for-Results (PforR) aims to support the Public Financial Management (PFM) strategy with a focus on enhancing human capital outcomes. This involves improving the efficiency and accountability of public financial management systems, particularly in the social sectors such as health, education, and social protection. The PforR will focus on two main result areas: improving public financial management systems and enhancing spending efficiency in social sectors.
